description: This file contains Jetpack Compose UI components for rendering chat messages, including message bubbles, typing indicators, tool call indicators, and code blocks within an Android chat application. It defines composable functions, styles, and some internal logic for displaying chat content with various roles and media types.

classes.name: ChatBubbleStyle
classes.description: Data class encapsulating styling details for chat bubbles, including alignment, background color, border color, and role label color.

methods.name: ChatMessageBubble
methods.description: Main composable function to display individual chat message bubbles, selecting style based on role and filtering displayable content parts.

methods.name: ChatBubbleContainer
methods.description: Internal composable defining the styled container for chat bubbles, arranging role label and content with proper layout and styling.

methods.name: ChatMessageBody
methods.description: Displays the message content parts, handling text and base64 images appropriately.

methods.name: ChatTypingIndicatorBubble
methods.description: Displays a typing indicator bubble with pulsing dots and 'Thinking...' text.

methods.name: ChatPendingToolsBubble
methods.description: Shows a bubble indicating running tools, with a list of tool displays.

methods.name: ChatStreamingAssistantBubble
methods.description: Displays a streaming response bubble with a 'Live' label.

methods.name: bubbleStyle
methods.description: Determines the style of a chat bubble based on the role (user, system, or assistant).

methods.name: roleLabel
methods.description: Returns a string label for a given role, used in UI.

methods.name: ChatBase64Image
methods.description: Displays an image from a base64 string, providing fallback text if loading fails.

methods.name: DotPulse
methods.description: Displays animated pulsing dots, used in typing indicator.

methods.name: PulseDot
methods.description: A small circle component with pulsing animation for typing indicator dots.

methods.name: ChatCodeBlock
methods.description: Displays formatted code blocks within the chat UI, optionally with language label.
